unsupported_license.title: Unsupported Veeam license on {host}
unsupported_license.description:
The Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 server at **{host}** reports the license **{license}**.

Community Edition, and servers whose license cannot be read, are not supported by this integration: entitlements differ and some REST API endpoints answer differently or not at all, so entities may be missing or unreliable.

The integration keeps running — nothing is blocked. If you hit problems, please include this license type in your bug report. Install a supported license, or remove the integration, to clear this warning.
